Cobb, I'll tell you the truth: my sister is on that boat. The raiders are anchored behind the island and won't move in this storm, and your shutter can send the beam out to sea only. You know what a dark night cost the Wren. Don't let it happen twice.
cases.note: should work: honest, kind, and it answers his duty

cases.input: Cobb, you've been alone up here a long time. Let me tell you about my sister: she taught me to sail, and she's never once been late home. Please light the lamp.
cases.note: kindness and a story warm him, but don't answer the raiders
